findings.description: Section 3.3 conditions the selected-direction.md metadata format on the Section 6.1 decision ("If YAML front-matter is selected in Section 6.1 [...] If the Section 6.1 decision chooses a non-front-matter format, use that same format here instead."). Section 6.1 is scoped to plan.md's compatibility with implement-with-ralph Phase 0's first-line check; selected-direction.md is not consumed by Phase 0 and has no first-line-check constraint. The source plan unambiguously requires YAML front-matter on selected-direction.md. Coupling the brainstorm metadata format to the 6.1 plan-format decision lets a future cycle skip the required brainstorm front-matter contract.
findings.resolution: Decoupled Section 3.3 brainstorm metadata format from Section 6.1: replaced the conditional language with an unconditional mandate to always write YAML front-matter on selected-direction.md. The Section 6.1 plan-format decision is now scoped to plan.md only.
findings.suggestedFix: Decouple 3.3 from 6.1: mandate YAML front-matter on selected-direction.md unconditionally (the source plan requires it). Keep 6.1's optional-format-choice scoped to plan.md only.

findings.description: Section 7 lists the conditional implement-with-ralph patch as step 5 but the body says "land this before steps 2-4 only if Section 6.1 resolution A is selected." Numbering a prerequisite step as the last item is internally contradictory and risks the future patch cycle treating Phase 0 as a final-step fix when YAML front-matter is chosen.
findings.resolution: Moved the conditional implement-with-ralph step from position 5 to position 0 in Section 7. Numbering now matches the in-text qualifier ("land this first, before steps 1-4, only if Section 6.1 resolution A is selected").
findings.suggestedFix: Renumber the conditional implement-with-ralph patch as step 0 (or call it out as a Step 0 prerequisite under the existing Section 7 prerequisite note), so the ordering and the in-text qualifier ("before steps 2-4") agree.
